brandStory.title: The House of PALKI
brandStory.text: Born from the idea that clothing should be carried, not just worn, PALKI began as a small tailoring atelier and grew into a house known for restraint, precision, and quiet luxury. Every collection is built around fabric first — sourced, tested, and cut by hand before a single stitch is placed.

about.vision: To build a fashion house where craftsmanship outlives trend — garments people return to for decades, not seasons.
about.mission: We design and construct considered clothing using ethically sourced materials, transparent production, and uncompromising finishing, delivered directly to the people who wear it.

values.title: Craftsmanship
values.description: Every seam is finished by hand and inspected before it leaves the atelier.

values.title: Restraint
values.description: We design by removing, not adding — nothing on a PALKI piece is decorative without purpose.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: Our materials, mills, and pricing are shared openly with every customer who asks.

values.title: Longevity
values.description: We build for the wardrobe you'll still be wearing in ten years, not ten weeks.

whyChooseUs.title: Hand-Finished Tailoring
whyChooseUs.description: Every piece passes through a master tailor's hands before it reaches yours.

whyChooseUs.title: Responsibly Sourced Fabric
whyChooseUs.description: Natural fibres sourced from mills we've personally audited.

whyChooseUs.title: Insured Nationwide Delivery
whyChooseUs.description: Tracked, insured shipping on every single order.

whyChooseUs.title: Lifetime Repairs
whyChooseUs.description: Free lifetime stitching repairs on all PALKI garments.
